subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about validated-lead acquisition for {Brand}. Since Jiji acquired Bangladesh's Bikroy in May 2026, its first expansion beyond Africa, the bar for proving lead quality in frontier classifieds moved up. Acquisition cost in your categories runs roughly $129 per buyer in home and furniture up to $377 in electronics, and that spread is where validation and incrementality decide your real cost per sale. We hold paid leads against a holdout, so the credited contacts are ones you would not have closed organically. Worth comparing against your source mix?
angle: fresh angle: Jiji->Bikroy expansion (sourced) + Nigeria classifieds-category CAC band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN classifieds CPS: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (Jiji/Bikroy acquisition, May 2026, confirmed via PR Newswire) + category CAC band ($129 home/furniture, $377 electronics, sourced via Shopify CAC-by-industry); MobUpps holdout-incrementality reference (no figure, so zero illustrative flags this stage); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native register; no X-not-Y.
